🚨 Ready to take the next step in your CBP journey? 🚨Join us for a LIVE Social Event! Chat with an exclusive panel of U.S. Border Patrol (USBP) recruiters!

✅ Hear directly from USBP recruiters about roles!✅ Have questions? Get them answered in real time!✅ Learn how you can complete your application and start your USBP career!

Whether you’re exploring opportunities or you’re already in the application process, this is your chance to connect, get answers, and take the next step.

📅 September 3, 2025, 1 PM – 4 PM ET
     Air and Marine Operations (AMO) – 1 PM ET
     Office of Field Operations (OFO) – 2 PM ET
     U.S. Border Patrol (USBP) – 3 PM ET 
📍 Where to watch: 
     Facebook: https://t.co/VvjaBbTP1p
     Instagram: https://t.co/cezTHp5b1l
     X: https://t.co/os2QQAIG10

TURN AMBITION INTO ACTION!
#CBP #USBP #CBPCareers #LawEnforcementJobs #CBPHiring
